probe_unsandboxed_reason: A version or doctor probe of codex reads its sign-in and writes its state under CODEX_HOME (~/.codex by default). The phase sandbox grants no write outside the cell, so the probe runs outside it.
note: default_model empty: codex picks the model compatible with active auth. This headless manifest declares NO model_tier_map of its own: model_tier_map_from points at the codex FAMILY table (codex-tmux.json) and LoadManifest adopts it — one declaration per family, never per transport (inbox codex-tier-map-single-source; the old copy here sat three model generations stale). The headless driver resolves its -m through the shared bridge.resolveTierModel ladder over that table.
